reviewsSample.author: Marcia Linn
reviewsSample.text: We had a great experience with Dewey. He was very personable, knowlegeable, and friendly from the start. I wouldn't hesitate to recommend hime to anyone needing a reliable plumber, thst won't over charge you!

reviewsSample.author: Jim Keller
reviewsSample.text: I had two new hot water heaters and an expansion tank installed in my garage after one of my older tanks started leaking from its rusted bottom.  Dewey came right out, inspected them for what I needed and then did a fantastic job replacing them at a very reasonable price. He is very knowledgeable, courteous and a real pro when it comes to all things plumbing related, not to mention also being a very nice guy! Thank you Dewey. I highly recommended B & C Plumbing and will absolutely use them again in the future whenever the need arises.

reviewsSample.author: Valerie Johnson
reviewsSample.text: We have worked with B&C Plumbing for years, both personally and professionally, and they have consistently exceeded our expectations. Their team is knowledgeable, dependable, and always provides high-quality workmanship. Whether it’s a small repair or a larger project, they respond quickly, communicate clearly, and get the job done right the first time.

reviewsSample.author: Jennifer Wilson
reviewsSample.text:
I can't say enough good things about B&C Plumbing. No one wants a plumbing emergency but B&C made the experience better.  From the person who answered the phone and got us quickly scheduled to the awesome technician, Dakota, they took great care of us and resolved the issue.

What I was most impressed by was that there was no attempt at upselling services which I've experienced at other places.  Dakota correctly diagnosed our problem, fixed it, and then was sure to stay long enough to make sure everything was in working order.  I'm definitely saving B&C in my phone for future use.  Great honest, reliable and affordable company!

reviewsSample.author: Hannah Lee
reviewsSample.text: Shaun and his team have helped my company out so many times getting our water issue resolved quickly! They are always prompt and make sure the work gets done right the first time! Definitely recommend!

reviewsSample.author: The Lost Storyteller
reviewsSample.text: Wonderful company! Prompt, Courteous, Efficient, and most importantly Affordable! Brandon was great explaining every detail, giving great suggestions and even answered concerns for possible future projects. I would highly suggest using them to anyone who has plumbing needs.

reviewsSample.author: Dennis Burger
reviewsSample.text:
It's never a good feeling to need the assistance of a plumber, but thank goodness I've found Ritter's for those times when I do. They arrived quickly, fixed my clogged drain in minutes, and charged me much less than the big corporate chains would.

I hope I don't have a clog again anytime soon, but if I do I won't even think about calling anyone else.

reviewsSample.author: Daniel Davenport
reviewsSample.text:
I can’t say enough good things about Ritters. From the very beginning, Brandon provided a fair and transparent quote and was extremely prompt with his response time. What really set them apart was their commitment to doing the job the right way, despite being thrown multiple unexpected curveballs along the way.
Even in freezing, wet weather conditions, Brandon stayed on site with his crew and worked through the challenges to make sure everything was completed properly. Communication and follow‑up throughout the entire process were excellent, which gave me a lot of confidence in the work being done.
The entire crew worked hard the whole time, paid close attention to detail, and made sure the job site was thoroughly cleaned up once the work was finished.
I would highly recommend Ritters to any of my closest friends and wouldn’t hesitate to use them again in the future.

reviewsSample.author: Jeremy Walker
reviewsSample.text: Ritter's Drain Cleaning services are exceptional & have reasonable prices. They came out quickly to assist with drain issues I was experiencing.  Brandon & Patrick were professional, very thorough, and worked quickly to resolve my issues. Highly recommend their services to anyone with plumbing needs.

reviewsSample.author: Court Campbell
reviewsSample.text:
Brandon Ritter is amazing at doing his job, making sure the job is done correctly
I originally called to get our kitchen sink unclogged in a 1920s home, not realizing he would also need to replace our kitchen sink pipes due to rust & 100 years old of build up. I can't thank you enough for everything you did for us, thank you for being so reasonably priced as well.

reviewsSample.author: Hal Kunnen
reviewsSample.text: Hayden at NuFlow leads the way in pipe repair. He thoroughly explained the process and diagnosed the problem. Basically old collapsing iron sewer pipes under the slab home. I’m a home inspector and remodeled our 40 year old home thinking that the unseen sewer pipes were good enough.  We found out 4 months after living in the home when half thy house clogged up.We were lucky that one half could be dug up and replaced but it resulted in re routing half the sewer line around the house. When the other half of the house started showing similar signs (smelly shower laundry room) we called Hayden at NuFlow. He was referred by the plumber that modified the previous side of our house. This second phase of work would have required 4 holes and trenches inside our newly remodeled kitchen and laundry to replace rotting pipes.  Hayden’s pipe re lining needed just one hole and we managed the process of repair while still living in the house. NuFlows plumbers were all professional and respectful.  We’re very happy with the results. Thanks to NuFlow.

reviewsSample.author: Erin McDonald
reviewsSample.text: We had a whole house sewer lining with these great guys from Nu Flow Phoenix.  They were great to work with, on time, professional, clean and super great explaining everything to us and communicating daily.  I had many companies come out to look at the pipes and they were by far the most professional and easiest to understand.  Would highly recommend them!

reviewsSample.author: S Paul Prinke Jr
reviewsSample.text:
5 Star Experience for sure across NuFlow's entire process. We choose  NuFlow Phoenix to address a drainage/waste water flow issue in a 50 year old home. From the beginning of the process, it was clear we made the right decision.  Our primary point of contact was Hayden, great gent, professional, knowledgeable, and honest. He walked us thru the recommendations as well as potential risk points we might encounter. Great communication during the entire process.

The team sent to accomplish the line scoping/videos, cleaning and relining get very high marks on professionalism and care of the property. Even when encountering an issue, the team was able to assess next steps, then correct, and then move on with completion.

Having looked at other options;  the quality of their work, minimal disruption to the home, and value of the service was excellent when compared to traditional drain/waste line repair/replacement. The warranty they provide to back up their service is stellar! In addition to Hayden, I also want to recognize Candace and Mia as they were highly responsive and provided great communication on account info and scheduling. Highly recommended business, NuFlow is focused on Customer Care. Thanks Team!!

reviewsSample.author: Sherri Penniston
reviewsSample.text:
The honesty of this company stood out to me.  My dishwasher and kitchen sink was backing up into the bathtub.  Nate came out and did a free camera inspection and was very honest with me that their product was overkill for my job.  Not many companies will be that honest with you.
He showed me the video and suggested a couple other ideas. I ended up with another company that came out within 2 hours and literally chiseled his way through the kitchen clean out in order to get the snake in.  He was able to get me flowing again.
Thank you Nate for your honesty.

reviewsSample.author: Ricardo
reviewsSample.text:
Huge shoutout to Nu Flow Phoenix for knocking this out of the park.

They helped clear decades—and I mean decades—of sludge and buildup from an old storm drain in a 1945 building I picked up about four months ago. Based on what came out, I’m pretty confident this drain hadn’t been properly serviced in close to 80 years. Not a small job, and definitely not a pretty one.

What really impressed me was their process. They didn’t just clear the line and disappear—they ran a camera through the system to identify exactly where the pipe runs and where it ties in, which is invaluable when you’re dealing with older buildings and mystery infrastructure. Clear explanations, solid visuals, and no guessing.

Professional, knowledgeable, and clearly experienced with older properties. If you’re dealing with legacy plumbing, storm drains, or anything underground that hasn’t seen daylight since Truman was president—these are your people.

Highly recommend.

reviewsSample.text: used the Trenchless Sewer Repair and did excellent work. And was done in a very short time (two days). Reasonable price for the repair required. Anthony, Alfonso, Daniel, Alain, Saul and of course Peter were all great. Process was amazing and has worked well since April install. reviewsSample.author: David McNicholas
reviewsSample.text:
As an owner of multiple long-term rental properties across the Western U.S., I work with contractors constantly. Reliable, high-caliber talent is mission-critical for maintaining my portfolio, ensuring compliance, and delivering a strong tenant experience.

NuFlow recently handled a highly complex sewer line sleeving job for one of my properties. The line had fallen into severe disrepair, requiring an advanced level of technical skill. NuFlow absolutely delivered.

Their team proved to be exceptionally skilled, reliable, and professional. They provided absolute transparency by delivering detailed pre- and post-repair video footage, confirming that the quality of their work is top-shelf while also backing it with a great commercial grade warranty. I highly recommend NuFlow for any complex plumbing infrastructure needs. They are standard-bearers in their field.

reviewsSample.author: Karen Van Sickle

We appreciate his honesty and explanation of their product, if needed down the road and his referral for a plumber (which is who we have used!)

reviewsSample.author: Carson Arnold
reviewsSample.text: Alex was punctual, efficient, and professional. He diagnosed various issues I brought to his attention, set out his plan of attack, and executed his work with careful attention to detail. Will definitely be called Tucson Plumbing Solutions again for any plumbing items down the road.

reviewsSample.author: Nora Haile
reviewsSample.text: Woke this morning to hot water bubbling out of our patio. When our usual plumber couldn't get to us until later in the day, our neighbor recommended Tucson Plumbing Solutions - and we are so glad they did! Scott answered the phone 2nd ring at 7:10am. Had a Ethan at our place within the hour. Hand excavated the pavers, id'd the issue, & discussed the options with us based on the old pipe condition (65 year old copper under the foundation footer). Opted for a PEX patch section as the copper segments no longer aligned due to house settling, which is likely what damaged the pipes over time. He replaced both the hot water and cold water segments that were in bad shape. All done within 2.5 hours, with a smile and a good attitude too! Reasonable pricing. Will definitely use again.

reviewsSample.author: Cindy Kappler
reviewsSample.text: We have used Tucson Plumbing Solutions for many projects - some planned, a couple emergency issues.  Derek has been the lead on several of them. He and his team do an excellent job.  The work is excellent, done in a timely manner, and exactly as we expect it to be.  Communication is great and we have always been more than happy with the A+ service we receive.

reviewsSample.author: Valerie Hilshorst
reviewsSample.text:
I cannot recommend Tucson Plumbing Services highly enough. We needed to complete minor repairs on our mother's house and arrange everything from out of state and during visits. The team worked around our schedule and ended up helping us through what ended up being major repairs. They fixed issues that had been there for 20+ years and been looked at numerous times! In the end everything worked correctly and looked great. Everyone that we worked with on the team was so nice and professional. Communication was quick and detailed. I would use them again.
We needed well repairs, toilet replacements, whole home water treatment replacement and general plumbing issues. They tackled it all!

reviewsSample.author: Steve Mitchell
reviewsSample.text: Leonard did a quick efficient job at the time he said he would. I didn't meet him but my wife did. She had nothing but praise for his thoroughness in replacing our old pressure regulator with a new one and a better ball valve that is supposed to last longer with Tucson's hard water. I inspected the job after got off work--it looks great! The price is fair, so no complaints there. I would recommend Leonard and Tucson Plumbing Solutions.

I highly recommend On The Way Plumbing to anyone with plumbing needs. Thank you, Sergio, and On The Way Plumbing!

reviewsSample.text: Sergio was responsive and did a great job replacing our faucets in our bathrooms. He worked with us and offered different solutions with examples. The service was fairly priced and he was very nice and professional. Highly recommend.

He walked me though what I needed to do to prevent any further leaking and damage to the home and was out promptly to replace the unit. I couldn’t ask for anything more. I highly recommend Sergio for all plumbing needs and will continue to use him in the future!

reviewsSample.text: We had a leak in our 2 year old Rheem tankless hot water heater last spring. I was in the service business in HVAC for over 30 years and I can tell you that he was exceptional when it came to fighting for us. If I could give him 6 stars he would have it. He spent hours negotiating on our behalf. We now have a new water heater and the one and only plumber we will recommend here in Oro Valley. Great person and family ran business. Cheers to Dinosaur plumbing!

reviewsSample.author: Jim Kelley
reviewsSample.text: They set up an appointment for us just a day or two ahead. Mike showed up right when he said he would. It was a complicated issue (we thought) with our reverse osmosis system. He figured out a brilliant solution (that was much better than the original installation),  and gave us the price all within minutes. A short time later he announced he was finished and charged us exactly the price he told us. We could'nt be happier with our new plumber!

reviewsSample.author: Kelly Cassidy
reviewsSample.text: After receiving four proposals from plumbers I selected Pine County Plumbing and so glad that I did.  They are responsive and professional.  Not only did they offer the best price to repair my outdoor drain from root invasion, but they also did it with the most advanced equipment and no need to tear up my yard.  I would highly recommend Pine Country Plumbing for any plumbing needs.

reviewsSample.author: Manzanita Village
reviewsSample.text: Mike with Pine Country plumbing came to our HOA to help resolve a tricky plumbing problem where a grinder pump line was broken owing to too much pressure from our private Low Pressure Sewer line. He came, put in a fix and returned to find that although he worked at it and did the best he could, he was unable to fix the problem so he helped us find another company to do it AND Mike did not charge us at all since, in his words, he could not fix it. Now THAT'S not your everyday company. We are very grateful to Pine Country and especially to Mike.

reviewsSample.author: Dustin Rigg
reviewsSample.text: Mike is great! honest... looked at the clamp done on the leak, and stated nothing needs to be done... Because I have buyers who wanted it to be replaced, he did it so it had a "3" year warranty... super fast and professional!

reviewsSample.author: Mike Anders
reviewsSample.text: Highly recommend! Great reliable plumbers that know what they’re doing, reliable and easy to communicate with. 5 star experience from a phone call to job completion.

reviewsSample.author: Rebekah Gandy
reviewsSample.text:
Phenomenal company and work.

When our old septic tank went kaput we got two quotes. One from BBB Septic and one from ABC Septic. After careful consideration we ended up choosing ABC. We were NOT disappointed. The level of care and communication they had was just top notch.

They kept us updated and in the loop with the weather that could postpone the job, explained thoroughly before and during the steps they would be taking for putting the new tank in and demolishing the old one. They also gave us clear instructions post installations as well. They arrived at 8am and were finished by 3pm. We appreciated this crew so much. Truly unsung heroes. I will be encouraging everyone with septic issues to reach out to ABC Septic.

Thank you so much!

reviewsSample.author: Sonja Winchester
reviewsSample.text:
I had a great experience with ABC Quick Pump. When my sewer alarm started going off after hours, I was stressed and unsure what to do. Cameron came out to my home during the emergency and quickly helped diagnose the issue. He determined that my pump was no longer working properly and explained everything clearly.

The next morning, he secured a new pump and returned promptly to install it. The whole process was smooth, professional, and efficient. I especially appreciated that he did not overcharge me and was honest about the work that needed to be done.

If you’re looking for reliable, responsive, and fair service, I highly recommend ABC Quick Pump.

reviewsSample.author: Cody H
reviewsSample.text: Service was prompt and effective, worker was knowledgeable of the system and able to get the job done quickly and effectively. We weren't aware of the additional access points to the system, but they excavated and oriented us to our setup to help us understand exactly how it worked and how to manage different types of problems that could occur with it.

reviewsSample.author: Eriks Zvers
reviewsSample.text:
We had a great experience with this septic service from start to finish. The team showed up on time, was friendly, professional, and clearly knew what they were doing. They handled the pumping efficiently and kept everything clean and organized throughout the process.

What stood out most was their willingness to go beyond just the basic service. They took the time to walk us through the condition of our system, pointed out a few issues we weren’t aware of, and explained everything in a way that was easy to understand. There was no pressure—just straightforward, honest feedback. They also offered to help put together a quote to address those items, which we really appreciated.

It’s hard to find service companies that are both knowledgeable and customer-focused, but they delivered on both. We feel a lot more confident about our system moving forward and will definitely be using them again for future maintenance and any repairs.

reviewsSample.author: Cynthia Jones
reviewsSample.text:
We were having a problem with our septic tank at our rental property.
Cameron was able to come out the same day as I called for service. He was polite, kind informative on time and very helpful in letting us know what we needed.
I would recommend Cameron to anyone needing septic services.
Thank you Cameron

reviewsSample.author: Crystal Kieffer
reviewsSample.text: I would highly recommend Kramer & Co to anyone who is needing a no BS technician to offer you peace of mind. I called Kramer & Co on the recommendation of a friend after one of the larger HVAC companies in the area quoted me an obscene amount of money for an entire system replacement. I am so happy I did. Kramer & Co, not only quoted me significantly less than that original company, but they were quick and friendly. I called them the day I received the original quote, they were out here the next day to take measurements, got me a quote for a new price a day later, and then a week later they were here to replace the until. Everyone I have dealt with has been super friendly, knowledge, and have given me the facts without trying to sell me on something I dont need. Please support a local business and use these guys, you won't be disappointed!

reviewsSample.author: Gil Newnum
reviewsSample.text:
Peak repair season and my A/C went out. I called around 10am and they were able to get a tech out by 1pm. Steve arrived with the parts on the truck, diagnosed the issue quickly, and had it fixed in less than an hour. He even checked the rest of the system while he was there.

Steve was very professional and took the time to walk me through what he was doing and why. Quick, reliable service at a reasonable price. Highly recommend!

reviewsSample.author: Danny Cheney
reviewsSample.text:
I hadn't used Kramer in many years. But decided to give them another try. We have had a rash of repairs and I am highly pleased. They are very affordable. I had to purchase a furnace and ac combo. The guys came out, worked hard, and did a great job. They really cleaned up the furnace closet and even did some extra work at no extra charge. Very pleased with the HVAC crew.
A week later we had an underground water leak (13 gallons a minute). The city shut off our water. Kramer was there first thing the next morning. Tim did a great job fixing the leak. Tim also worked on our toilets and got them all fixed with no leaks. I would highly recommend Kramer.

reviewsSample.author: Tom Seliga

reviewsSample.author: Gina Brearley
reviewsSample.text:
I had a tenant report a leaking shower drain in one of my rental properties, and I strongly encouraged the owner to contact Millennium Plumbing for an urgent repair. I’m so glad we did.

Alejandro and his supervisor, Victor, worked diligently to locate the source of the leak in a small and challenging area. Despite the complexity of the job, they remained committed to finding the problem and reassured us throughout the process that they would get it resolved.

The repair required multiple visits, but they maintained consistent, transparent communication every step of the way. They truly went above and beyond by utilizing the existing gasket whenever possible, helping to avoid unnecessary costs while still ensuring a quality repair.

In the end, they successfully fixed the leak and even patched the drywall, leaving the area in great condition. Most importantly, the tenant was extremely pleased with the work performed.

I couldn't have asked for a better team to work with. Alejandro and Victor demonstrated professionalism, honesty, and a strong commitment to customer service. I highly recommend Millennium Plumbing to anyone in need of reliable and trustworthy plumbing services.

reviewsSample.author: Lisa Cavanagh
reviewsSample.text: I spoke with your receptionist this afternoon and besides being helpful, she went out of her way to try to get me an install appt. before my b-day barbeque over the holiday weekend. My contractor ended up coming through and moved some things around to get my new toilet installed before my party. I will definitely keep your company in mind should I need any future plumbing projects because of her exceptional customer service!

reviewsSample.author: April Rehberg
reviewsSample.text: We had an excellent experience with Millenium Plumbing. We found both Luis and Oscar to be very knowledgeable. They answered all our questions, provided a comprehensive  description of all the work that would be completed and did not over-quote with unnecessary fixes as we had experienced with other companies. Oscar, who completed the install of our water heater as well as diagnosed pipe rattling was thorough, communicative, friendly and patient with all our questions. The entire experience from start to finish was wonderful. We will definitely hire them again for upcoming jobs.

reviewsSample.author: J H
reviewsSample.text: Millennium did an incredible job diagnosing and clearing a clogged line, then hydrojetting the main line in my 65-yr old house. Luis and his partner did a fantastic job explaining ahead of time their approach, the processes they planned to use, and the cost (which was very reasonable and spot-on!). When the time came, Luis thoroughly explained what I was seeing on the monitor while he fed the camera down the line and even provided me with a copy of the video, making it a great learning experience for me. He answered my many questions thoroughly and did a great job explaining how the plumbing works in my particular house and how city water and sewer feed into, and out of, my house. In addition, his partner crawled under the house to inspect the condition of all pipes, reported any concerns to me (there were none), and made recommendations as to how I can maintain the health of my system moving forward. They were extremely pleasant to work with, fast and efficient, and very knowledgeable. I have since highly recommended this family-owned business to several friends and colleagues, and will only use Millennium in the future. Thank you, Luis, for doing a superb job and for running an honest, trustworthy business!

reviewsSample.author: Forrest Mowles
reviewsSample.text:
Apologies to the owner for the delay on this very much earned rating.

First if I could give a higher rating I would. They went above and beyond on the work. So to start off they came to help my 94 year old neighbor late Sunday night to fix a broken water main.

Pricing:
Fair, reasonable and about 50% less that the big commercial plumbers. I can’t promise this difference but it was for us.

Customer service:
Nicest guys I have ever met. They employ veterans and gave a 94 year old vet the best customer service she could have asked for. They were honest and did everything to put the property back the way it was. Treated her with respect.

Ultimately if you could pick a plumber, this would be it. I have added them to my phone as my Sacramento go to.

reviewsSample.author: Briana Schwartz
reviewsSample.text:
We had an amazing experience with this plumbing company! They installed a water softener for us and did an excellent job from start to finish. Everything was explained clearly, the work was done professionally, and they were very respectful of our home.

We also had a plumbing issue come up unexpectedly, and when we called, they were able to come out the very same day! Their quick response, professionalism, and quality of work really stood out.

It’s hard to find a company that genuinely cares about their customers, but this team absolutely does. We highly recommend them for any plumbing needs!

reviewsSample.author: Joel Reagan
reviewsSample.text: Amazing service! We had an emergency on a Sunday evening and Gabriel was at our house within the hour. His team provided a timeline and stayed true to their estimation. I would highly recommend!

reviewsSample.author: Robbie Flint
reviewsSample.text:
So grateful for these guys coming out! Anthony was awesome. He came later in the day due to a prior appointment taking longer than expected(I work in the repair industry so I completely understand!)
Even though it was later in the evening he never made us feel like it was rushed or an inconvenient time.
Our house is on septic and we had a sewage back up coming from the clean out. Anthony got right to work, he had it snaked and scoped very quickly, invited me to watch the camera to show me what he was seeing. Took the time to explain the technical part of what was needed and gave me a realistic time frame of when the repair needed to be done. No scare tactics, no up sale, just straight forward information followed by a pleasant conversation.
Over all personable, professional, understanding, and took the time to explain what was happening.
I appreciate them for putting us at ease in a not ideal situation!

reviewsSample.author: Diana Messina
reviewsSample.text:
Anthony and Gabriel definitely know how to immediately clear a clog in my sewer lateral. I appreciated the time they took to explain the current issue and potential further issues with my older sewer lateral. I am considering having them do further work because I feel they are trustworthy and being honest with my plumbing situation.

One week later - Anthony dug up my corroded sewer lateral joint that caused the above issue and installed a new joint of updated material. Very professional work. He worked carefully not to disrupt my paver patio, showed me the corroded joint, and explained the issue each step of the way. The end product, the garden spot perfectly filled as if never touched.

While here Anthony did some shower fixture work and was very honest to conclude that the issue was easily fixed right then and there.

My standard is to hire experts that are licensed and knowledgeable in their work, honest, and responsive. I will be a return customer next time I need a plumber and recommend DrainPros to others.

reviewsSample.author: Elena Valencia
reviewsSample.text: I was desperate for a Plumber. Anthony was great. It was very obvious that he new  what the problem was and repaired it. I liked them so much that the company will be returning later this month to fix other plumbing issues.

reviewsSample.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

I had an outstanding experience with Jairo at Speed Plumbing Pros and highly recommend him to anyone looking for an honest, reliable plumber in the Sacramento area.

I needed plumbing work done at my 8-unit apartment building, and from the very first visit, Jairo impressed me with his professionalism, knowledge, and integrity. Instead of trying to sell me the most expensive repair, he carefully inspected the issue and explained multiple solutions, outlining the pros, cons, and costs of each option. He truly worked within my budget while making sure I understood what was best for both my immediate needs and the long-term health of the property.

After the inspection, he scheduled the repair within two days and worked around my availability, which I really appreciated. He arrived on time, completed the work efficiently, and left everything clean. His communication throughout the entire process was excellent.

If you’re looking for a Sacramento plumber, whether for apartment buildings, rental properties, residential plumbing, drain issues, water lines, plumbing repairs, or general plumbing services, Jairo is someone you can trust. He’s knowledgeable, dependable, reasonably priced, and takes pride in doing the job right the first time.

As a bonus, Jairo is bilingual (English and Spanish), making communication easy for a wider range of customers.

Thank you, Jairo, for your honesty, excellent workmanship, and outstanding customer service. You’ve definitely earned my trust, and I’ll be recommending Speed Plumbing Pros to anyone who needs a great plumber.

reviewsSample.author: Edward Chan
reviewsSample.text:
We recently had Jairo install a full house sediment filter, water softener, and a proper drain line with air gap, and we’re very happy with the whole experience. From the start, Jairo was easy to communicate with and very professional. He took the time to answer all of my questions and made sure I understood everything before getting started.

His pricing was transparent and affordable, with no surprises. He showed up right on time and completed the installation neatly and in an organized way. You can really see the quality and care in his workmanship.

We truly appreciate Jairo’s professionalism and attention to detail. I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend him to anyone looking for reliable plumbing work.

reviewsSample.author: Jesse A
reviewsSample.text: Just bought a house and it needed a new water pressure regulator. My realtor referred Speed Plumbing Pros and I'm glad he did. Jairo was friendly and professional. He did a great job. Will definitely use him again.

reviewsSample.author: Luis Arroyo
reviewsSample.text:
Super happy with the work from Speed Plumbing Pros. The before and after is a huge difference. They replaced my main water riser, added a 1/4-turn ball valve, a new hose bibb, and put in a clean irrigation “T” with a new 1/4-turn valve, and hooked up the PVC to the irrigation line.

I provided the Moen smart water device and they installed it no problem, which was awesome for my insurance setup.

They were super quick to respond and got me scheduled as soon as they had availability—ended up being within a week, which I really appreciated.

Everything looks way cleaner and is much easier to use now. You can tell they actually care about doing it right. Definitely recommend Speed Plumbing Pros if you need plumbing work done.

reviewsSample.author: Manuel Pacheco
reviewsSample.text:
Excellent service! I haveSpeed Plumbing Pros has been incredibly helpful with work around my home. They provide excellent customer service, high-quality workmanship, and truly know what they’re doing.

I’ve needed their help twice, and both times the service was outstanding and very fast. The first time, I accidentally broke an internal water pipe inside one of my walls. Jairo responded quickly and helped fix the issue right away. He also replaced my main water valve, which was old and leaking, along with the damaged pipe.

The second time, I didn’t even try to fix it myself. I had a water leak in my yard and realized it was coming from a pipe connected to my irrigation system valves. Jairo took care of everything. He replaced the necessary parts and fixed the leak completely.

I would definitely recommend Speed Plumbing Pros for any plumbing work you need. I’m very happy with their service and glad I found someone I can truly trust.

reviewsSample.author: Joel August
reviewsSample.text:
We recently purchased a home in the Bullard High area and our realtor initially recommended another company for our sewer scope. Unfortunately, the experience left us with absolutely zero confidence in the condition of our sewer line, and our inspection contingency expired during the rushed process.

Fast forward to after closing we called Chris Rooter, and honestly, we only wish we had called him from the very beginning. Chris and his daughter were incredibly responsive, professional, knowledgeable, and truly went above and beyond in every way possible.

Chris didn’t just perform a sewer inspection and leave. He stayed extra time helping me locate exactly where roots were entering the sewer line and even helped dig a 4-foot trench to uncover an old koi pond drain that was causing the issue. That level of care and dedication is almost unheard of these days.

I genuinely cannot recommend Chris Rooter  enough. He clearly knows exactly what he’s doing, takes pride in his work, and treats his customers like family. He showed me in detail the camera foot Where is the other inspector did not share anything with me live which I would’ve really appreciated as a homeowner. His daughter was fantastic as well… such an awesome father-daughter team.

If you are purchasing an older home anywhere in the Fresno area, do yourself a favor and call them first. I would recommend this duo 100 times over for any sewer scope or sewer-related inspection.

reviewsSample.author: Georgia Darnell
reviewsSample.text: Heard their ad on the local radio and thought I would give them a try. I was unsure about some of our well set up and wanted to look into getting a water filter.  They got to us the next day to look at our well and water system. We primarly worked with Russell. What a great guy! Also had occasion to talk to Garrett and Chico and was equally impressed. The price was VERY reasonable to add a filter for iron to our current system and I was impressed with how professional the team was. Genuinely good  and professional guys, with very reasonable prices and the knowledge to get the jobs you need done. I am happy to give them 5 stars and encourage homeowners to pick them for their well services!

reviewsSample.author: Amanda Ann Rafferty
reviewsSample.text:
Triad Water Solutions is absolutely MORE than just some company, they have become my forever Water Solutions go-to company and should be yours too! Russel typically gets stuck making the drive all the way out to Oak Run to help solve an incredibly high level of iron in my well water. Every time he is slapping on his cape to be my hero, he manages to ALWAYS be friendly, personable, professional and above everything, a true gentleman in business (a rare quality for any businesses these days). He has always been very upfront with the cost, been super quick to come out when called, even often adding me into an already long day of planned work. Russel takes the time to show and explain the issues he found. More amazingly, he never gets annoyed when I'm asking many questions that are sometimes a bit weird or show I'm unfamiliar with wells in general. He just smiles and answers without any problems. While for me and my well, Russel became 'the face of the company', anyone I've spoken with on the phone have all been equally as great and just as respectful!

If you want a Water Solutions company who is above 'acceptable' and above 'some company' who helps solve the puzzles with your well (and other needs pertaining to water),  the ONLY COMPANY TO CALL -*TRIAD WATER SOLUTIONS*. You will not regret making the call. I will bet that like myself, you end up feeling more like a lifetime family friend with them rather than just another customer!

*Thank you all and especially to the 'hero cape wearer', Russel - my true appreciation and gratitude for all you have continued to do so I can enjoy clean & clear water! So you know, you are a truly stuck as my 'well guy' forever and Triad is the ONLY company I trust and absolutely will always recommend every time to call!

reviewsSample.author: Marie Burke
reviewsSample.text:
Our water well pump shut off and the  controller showed an error code in a new home.   Triad Well
came out, diagnosed the problem, explained what was needed, gave a written estimate,
pulled the pump, found the short AND installed the correct pump.
I have more water, more power flow

reviewsSample.author: Noah Miranda
reviewsSample.text:
I have used Triad Water Solutions multiple times when updating my well pump, installing a water softener, installing a whole house water filtration, and servicing the equipment. They have always been very professional, very responsive, extremely knowledgeable (I have contacted Chico with many questions), and fairly priced!
Triad has gained my business and I have referred their name to many family members and friends.

Thank you Triad Water Solutions!

reviewsSample.author: Alisha Noe
reviewsSample.text:
I have to say, Triad Water Solutions is an absolute gem of a business. They might be new in the game, but they've got a heart of gold and expertise to boot. We got in touch with them because we had some questions about water storage and potential pumping options, and they didn't disappoint.

What really stood out was their commitment to customer satisfaction. They're based out of Redding, California, but they traveled a whopping 2.5 hours just to have a face-to-face consultation with us. That kind of dedication is hard to come by.

But it wasn't just about the miles they put in; it was the depth of their knowledge that impressed us the most. They had recommendations for every single water question we threw at them. It's clear they've done their homework and are passionate about what they do.

Not only did they provide recommendations, but they also went the extra mile by setting up a temporary water supply line for us. This allowed us to start using our storage tanks while we worked on a more permanent solution. It was a game-changer for us, and it showed that they truly cared about our needs.

What really sold us on Triad Water Solutions was their genuine expertise in the field. They knew their stuff inside and out, and their solutions were practical and tailored to our specific situation. They made what could have been a stressful experience into a breeze, and we couldn't be happier with the results.

If you're in need of water-related help, these folks are the ones to call. They combine professionalism, knowledge, and a genuine desire to help you find the best solution. Triad Water Solutions, thank you for making our water worries a thing of the past!

reviewsSample.author: JayEl Gee
reviewsSample.text: Professional and affordable! They got the job done fast and cost much less than the other 4 plumbing companies who gave me estimates. Very happy with their services and have already recommended easy flow to family and friends. Don't hesitate to give these guys a call!

reviewsSample.author: Max H
reviewsSample.text:
Easy Flow was trustworthy, dependable, and experienced in addressing and fixing a drain problem at my house.  I had flooding in my entire bathroom.  Two other plumbing companies came out to my house – charging me a total of $1500 for snaking that “couldn’t clear the drain,” along with telling me that my backyard area did not have a “clean out,” and recommending several thousands of dollars of work without fixing anything.  One of the companies had told me the main line piping had clearly “collapsed,” a “clean out” would have to be installed, and that several points of expensive digging/pipe replacement would be required.

I am so thankful I got a third opinion.  When Easy Flow came to my house, turns out I did have a “clean out,” the piping had not “collapsed,” and that there were root intrusions at different areas of the old cast iron piping causing the blockage shown to me on a clearly recorded video.  Different options were provided based on the circumstances, and we went with a lining of the old piping for repair for the section of piping that needed to be addressed.

This stressful situation was remarkably handled by Easy Flow.  In particular, Chris and his team communicated clearly, were patient with my questions, presented the actual plumbing situation that I was facing, and fixed the problem.  The cost was well under recommendations that were made by the two prior plumbing companies who seemingly were not forthcoming and creating additional work.

reviewsSample.author: Vicki Krivoski
reviewsSample.text: We had a major issue with our lateral sewer line and Easy Flow came to our rescue. They handled the permits, street traffic control, signage, etc. and got the job done quickly and professionally!! Chris  was our contact and Carlos supervised on site. A great team of hard working, experienced guys. We highly recommend them!

reviewsSample.author: Andrew Wayne Post
reviewsSample.text: I had a major blockage in my main line going out to the city main sewer and had called a few people. I wish I called these guys first. The people who showed up tried to rip me off. Saying I needed to do some liner immediately, and along with that, they were going to charge an exorbitant amount. I got a hold of Bill and he gave me a better quote the liner work, and said I did not have to do it anytime soon and offered me a less costly solution. These are definitely the guys to call with drain issues.

reviewsSample.author: Abe V
reviewsSample.text:
Joey from PlumTech was professional from the moment he arrived. He provided a fair, transparent quote and took the time to thoroughly evaluate the issue rather than simply recommending the work another plumber had suggested. He confirmed what actually needed to be replaced, which immediately gave us confidence that we were receiving an honest assessment instead of an unnecessary repair.

Joey and Shay worked efficiently and professionally throughout the entire project. We initially weren’t sure whether replacing the shower trim kit and escutcheon plate would be sufficient or if the entire shower valve needed to be replaced. Joey clearly explained both options, including the benefits and pricing for each. While either repair would have addressed the issue, he recommended replacing the entire valve as the best long-term solution.

He explained that replacing the valve would require opening the drywall behind the shower, but assured us he would patch and texture the wall so that all we would need to do afterward was paint. That’s exactly what they did. In approximately four hours, they had replaced the entire shower valve, repaired and textured the drywall beautifully, and completed the installation with exceptional craftsmanship.

What impressed us most was the attention to detail. The drywall repair blended seamlessly, the new valve functions perfectly, and before leaving they cleaned and polished both bathroom fixtures, leaving the work areas spotless.

I can’t recommend PlumTech highly enough, especially Joey and Shay. Their honesty, workmanship, professionalism, attention to detail, and fair pricing truly set them apart. It’s refreshing to find a company that prioritizes doing the job right over simply selling the most expensive repair. If you’re looking for plumbers you can trust, PlumTech is an excellent choice.

reviewsSample.text: I had my kitchen and bathroom sink faucets replaced. He was professional and left the spaces clean. He was also very attentive to details and I was comfortable having him in my house. I highly recommend his service and will definitely use him again.

He also rerouted the piping to make them easily accessible for future maintenance. We highly recommend them for any and all plumbing jobs.

reviewsSample.author: Marie Renier
reviewsSample.text: Excellent in every way! The scheduling was a breeze with the wonderful office lady and the workers showed up on time. We will hire them again in the future! Well run family business!

reviewsSample.author: Alexis
reviewsSample.text: From the call to the plumber I had amazing service. They weren't going to be able to make it out till Tuesday and I really needed peace of mind and to get my issue remedied to find out why my basement flooded. Jo took the time to help get me fit in same day and Lorin came was kind, efficient and thorough with telling me what happened. I hope to not need a plumber but when and if the time comes again, I will be using them.

reviewsSample.author: David Yarbrough
reviewsSample.text:
I called Father & Sons Plumbing about a sump pump problem. My sump pump had died and I replaced it myself but the new sump pump wasn't working.

The service was fast, friendly, and reasonably priced. I would highly recommend them to anyone needing plumbing help.

reviewsSample.author: Pam Kruger
reviewsSample.text:
We were notified on December 28, 2024 that we must have a water leak as we were using too much water and the city was going to be shutting it off. Don had A company that came out located the leak. Told Don he’d have to find somebody else to fix it. He was so disappointed as now it is 7pm on Saturday night. He has no water at all as the leak was in the main water line coming up to his house.
I went on the Internet and had found Peaks Plumbing. I immediately sent a text messages  that we needed someone asap. Jacob owner of Peaks Plumbing said he’d be out the next morning, which was a Sunday.
Gave us an estimate said he would be here Monday morning at 10.
Jacob was very prompt, professional, experienced, communicated well, reassured my uncle Don who is 90 that he would fix it.
Charge was normal rate even with it being a Sunday!  I recommend Peaks Plumbing for future repairs. He made it for us to have a Happy New Year!

reviewsSample.author: Nikki Cohen
reviewsSample.text: We had our septic system replaced . We had issues with the permit and Jacob and his team hung in there and got the it handled. It was a big project with lots of cold weather to deal with. I highly recommend them. They stayed in touch, kept their agreements, completely professional and the project was done without interruption to our home. The entire team worked well with us and each other. First rate company.

reviewsSample.author: Patricia Acheson
reviewsSample.text:
Peak Plumbing was absolutely amazing. We had a leak in our main water line which was a very stressful situation for a new home owner, and these guys were so great to work with. They were extremely affordable, efficient, and gave us over the top customer service. Not to mention their work was done perfectly. They were also extremely helpful when it came to talking with our insurance agents. They had to speak with mine about 5 times and not once were they annoyed- they were just so nice and patient about everything.

We will be using them for all our plumbing needs moving forward.

reviewsSample.author: Vinny Diniz
reviewsSample.text: Jacob Smyth and his crew are nothing but amazing. I contacted them to replace my sink. They were extremely attentive and responsive.  They are very professional. Jacob is a real gentleman who really cares about his customers. I highly recommend them!

reviewsSample.author: Rick Castañeda
reviewsSample.text: Discovered our water was leaking but still useable. Started checking out plumbers on the web. Customer Reviews on Nextdoor, spoke with neighbors. Each time Peak Plumbing ended up in the conversation. Being a 'word of mouth' person, I gave them a call. Spoke with Jacob, he came out and took a look.  The WH was definitely shot. Not only was it leaking but he showed me where it was actually split open where the seam is on the backside. Somebody was definitely watching out for us. The Wife and I have always been interested in a 'tankless' system. We asked Jacob for a quote. He described a tankless system  product, Navian. Mentioned he has installed other Navian systems in our neighborhood, Marianna Butte. Price wise, his quote was right on. Excellent warranty. We decide to give Peak Plumbing and Jacob a go. By the end of the next working day, we had our own tankless system installed. We've had some time to use it, showers, laundry, cleaning, etc. It's amazing ! Hot water comes out immediately, no more letting it run for a few minutes before it gets hot. No more wasting water. We highly recommend Peak Plumbing. So thankful for Jacobs expertise and direction.  Knows his stuff !

reviewsSample.author: Robert Holden
reviewsSample.text:
If I could give Burton’s Plumbing 6 stars, I would!

We had a leak under our floor that required jackhammering through the concrete, digging out the damaged pipe, and making repairs. From the moment they walked through the door, I knew we were in good hands.

What impressed me most wasn’t just their skill—it was how much they genuinely cared. They were considerate of our home, our animals, the mess the work would create, and the stress that comes with a major repair. They kept us informed throughout the entire process and treated us with kindness and respect.

This is a family-owned business, and it shows. They worked hard, found the problem, repaired it, and had everything completed by Friday afternoon. Their professionalism, honesty, and compassion turned what could have been a very stressful situation into a positive experience.

I highly recommend Burton’s Plumbing to anyone needing plumbing services. Exceptional work, exceptional people, and a company you can trust.

Thank you for taking such good care of us!
Rob Holden

reviewsSample.author: Justin Scott
reviewsSample.text: Rich and David came to put in a new water heater. Incredibly friendly and professional. This was a great experience and I will be recommending them and Burtons for any plumbing related needs!

reviewsSample.author: Joshua Dudley
reviewsSample.text: Great communication and fair in price. These guys showed up and worked great as a team to put the final touches on our bathroom remodel and replaced the water heater. We will absolutely use them for any plumbing needs!

reviewsSample.author: Nikki Thomas
reviewsSample.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

I can’t say enough good things about Burton’s Plumbing and the owners, Mike and Kasey Burton! When my sewer line collapsed, it was a stressful and overwhelming situation—but from the very first call,  Kasey was compassionate, professional, and incredibly prompt in getting things fixed.

They treated my problem as if it were their own. The level of care, communication, and dedication they showed was beyond anything I’ve experienced with a plumbing company before. Mike and Kasey took the time to explain every step, kept me informed throughout the repair process, and made sure everything was done the right way.

Their entire team was amazing—hard-working, respectful, and clearly take pride in what they do. It’s rare to find a company that combines such skill and professionalism with genuine kindness, but Burton’s Plumbing does exactly that.

What started as a plumbing emergency actually turned into a great connection—I can honestly say we built a friendship through the process. Mike and Kasey are truly awesome people who care about their customers on a personal level.

If you need plumbing work done and want a team that goes above and beyond, Burton’s Plumbing is absolutely the one to call. They’re simply the best!

reviewsSample.author: Paul Conlon
reviewsSample.text:
Valli Construction (Portland, CT.) has done the necessary site prep work for a 58’ x 40’ shop building soon to be built in my backyard. Mike (owner), Tom (excavation) and Jackie (office) have been great to work with on this project. They were highly recommended by a long time friend who had the same type of site prep work done many years ago on his 30’ x 60’ shop building.
Give them a call, they’ll treat you right!

reviewsSample.author: Ginger LaBella
reviewsSample.text: We had a sinkhole open up in our residential driveway due to improper installation of our underground gutter drains when the house was built 12 years prior. So it was a bit of an emergency situation. Valli responded quickly and brought a third-party professional who had a scope that could be put down into the drain system to locate the underground problem. This helped them be more sure what they were dealing with for quoting and planning the project. They moved quickly to start and complete the repair which involved removing large boulders and other fill material, installing new drain pipe, and properly backfilling and grading. They also coordinated with a third-party paver who we paid directly. Since Valli pulled together everyone needed to bring the project together, it was easy for us. The work was professional, and they were nice to work with.

reviewsSample.author: Tim Nolan
reviewsSample.text:
The Valli team completely transformed my front yard. They were professional, timely, and easy to work with. If you need site work done call the best!
Tim Nolan

reviewsSample.author: Christine Valie
reviewsSample.text: Reached out to Valli Construction after my brother used them to get rid of their well and convert to city water. I needed the same excavate, crush my well and move on. This company and family were so professional, flexible and courteous and super easy to do business with. Being a woman and trying to get things done in my house all the other guys glazed over what had to be done, but Valli Construction explained exactly what had to be done and how. They came in took care of the job and at the end of it I didn’t have to clean up after them. I wouldn’t have even known they were there. Thank you to all of you!!! I highly recommend!!!

reviewsSample.text: They are a great company to work with and answer all your questions on installing a riser on the septic tank. I highly recommend Valli Construction, they have been around a long time and still provide great service.

I noticed my septic tank was overfilled and needed to be pumped as soon as possible. I called C.M. Kristman first thing in the morning. The office staff was super nice and knowledgeable. I recommend their service for sure! Thanks!

reviewsSample.author: Chris Johnson
reviewsSample.text:
“Outstanding!”
I have worked with Kristman for 8+ years and without a doubt they are a top shelf company. Their Professionalism, Expertise, Responsiveness, Customer Service and Personnel makes them the #1 choice for pumping, maintenance and installation….. based on my experience I fully recommend Kristman for all your septic needs

reviewsSample.author: Michael Forbes
reviewsSample.text: Eliza and the team at C M Kristman are excellent, highly responsive, professional, and very helpful to deal with. Selling a house and finding out your system is not up standard can be a jolting experience for all involved. The Kristman team was highly knowledgeable, very responsive,and flexible dealing with us and the property buyers. I highly recommend them.

reviewsSample.author: Joe Frederick
reviewsSample.text:
CM Kristman designed and installed (pending) a new septic system (holding tank)

Elisa Kristman was amazing. She was very responsive to all of our questions and concerns. So much that after our initial phone conversation she agreed to have a conference call ( after hours) with my sisters to explain how the process worked and possible scenarios. We were selling our parents house that had failed the buyers septic inspection. The system was still  viable but was showing it's age - the cesspool was acting as a holding tank but the drain field was operational.
The knowledge and respect Elisa and her company had in the county was priceless. She not only knew the soil in our area (she installed a similar system in house a few doors away) but had the respect of the county inspector. That respect, in our opinion, made it possible to get on the county's schedule much earlier than anticipated due to a cancellation. Elisa kept the lines of communication open and explained every step.
While a holding tank is not the best case scenario, Eliza was able to work with the county to secure a Belt and suspenders scenario - tie into the existing drain field.  She also, in our opinion, set the minds of the buyers at easy. We closed Nov 1st, only 13-days after the initial closing date.  Currently, the tank is scheduled to be installed in January, weather permitting.
As for price, it was inline with what we had researched and anticipated. But the experience/contacts Elisa had in the county made the decision a no-brainer.

Thank u so much for coming out so promptly to fix a leak in the wall behind the kitchen sink !! My daughter said u were very nice . Very reasonable
too ! Will keep u in phone for any future plumbing needs 😊.

reviewsSample.author: Matthew Clegg
reviewsSample.text:
Mr Harley came out to my mothers house, after she had multiple company’s give her estimates, he took a look at what she had going on and was not only kind enough to beat the price, he went the extra mile to explain to her how she was being way over charged! Harley is a man of his word and has a great work ethic along with a heart for his customers! I will highly recommend his services to not only my friends and family, but to all my surrounding neighbors as I see so many plumbing companies in and out of our neighborhood.

Thank you rootscooter plumbing!

reviewsSample.author: Scott
reviewsSample.text: This is an honest, family run business. I called looking to "upgrade" my water heater to a newer fancier model, and they took the time to clarify my needs, asked about the brand & model I have and proceeded to tell me I already had a great water heater that would likely last another 10 years. This is what you call honesty and integrity. They've saved me a bunch of money and now are my go-to company for any future plumbing work. Thanks so much Harley!

reviewsSample.author: Patti Yasuhara
reviewsSample.text: John Merryman is an excellent plumber! Returns call/text quickly & very knowledgeable. We had a nightmare water main leak, dealing with the Board of Water. John handled our problem efficiently & reasonably priced. Saved us in a huge way!          We're very grateful!   Ken & Patti Yasuhara

reviewsSample.author: ruy carlos
reviewsSample.text:
We got our place in need of a major plumbing renovation. John Merryman with Low Cost Drain Plumbing got a major role into the project. Foreseeing potential issues and advising the best route for having everything addressed in a professional way with competitive pricing.
Straight forward, accountable and honest.

reviewsSample.author: Kenler Schwartz
reviewsSample.text: Plumber John was very pleasent & personable. He responded within 30 min. to return my call. I told him I had a leaking gas water heater that I needed to remove & install a new one I purchased. He quickly arrived within 20 min. Installation & recommendations was done within an hour. He was very knowledgeable & made everything looked so easy to do. His Labor prices are extremely affordable. I Highly Recommend Plumber John's services. My Family & I are looking forward in the near future to utilize his expertise.

reviewsSample.author: Kaina Lingaton
reviewsSample.text:
John was great to work with.  He returned my call right away and came by that evening to give me an estimate.  The job was to replace my old cracking cast-iron drains; it was not yet leaking so it was not an emergency job.  He was very easy to work with and very informative.  He explained in detail everything that needed to be done and made sure that I understood.  He also gave some options on how I could proceed with the whole job at once or if I wanted to do it in phases.  He was very knowledgeable, patient, and clear in his explanations.

The price for his work was significantly less than the competition.  I will definitely call John for future plumbing needs.

reviewsSample.author: Ray Madigan
reviewsSample.text:
I called John and he answered immediately. He came the same day and quoted a very fair price. He worked quickly and professionally and made helpful suggestions regarding the job and other related issues around the house.
I absolutely recommend him and if I need a plumber again will definitely call Low Cost Drain Plumbing. Cannot say enough good things about him.

reviewsSample.author: Kaimana McGill
reviewsSample.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ 5 Stars!

Mahalo to Josiah, owner and operator of United Drain Techs!

I can’t recommend him enough. From the very beginning, it was obvious that he genuinely cares about his clients. Instead of trying to upsell me, he took the time to research the most affordable toilet at Home Depot that still had great reviews. That level of honesty and customer care is hard to find.

Josiah and his helper did an amazing job from start to finish. They completely replaced my toilet and were in and out in about 30 minutes. The installation was flawless, the caulking was clean and professionally done, and they left the area spotless when they were finished.

On top of that, they even offered to haul away and dispose of my old toilet, saving me the extra hassle.

If you’re looking for a plumber who is honest, reliable, efficient, and truly cares about his customers, I highly recommend Josiah and United Drain Tech. Mahalo again for the outstanding service—I will definitely be calling you for any future plumbing needs!

reviewsSample.author: Daisha Santiago
reviewsSample.text: United Drain tech is the best pluming company we have ever experienced! We had a slight leak in our shower and wanted to resolve the problem. So my husband called another plumbing company and they came to check it out and ended up changing the cartridge. But my shower was still leaking. We called them back to check it again due to us paying a hefty amount for them to change the cartridge and they had an entire invoice filled of things to change after the second visit which would’ve totaled to $7,000. I refused to pay that so I wanted another plumbers opinion and figure out what the issue would be. I ended up calling United Drain Techs and they came so quick to check the issue and sure enough, the first plumbing company didn’t install the cartridge correctly! Thank you so much United Drain Techs for your professionalism, outstanding communication, quick arrival and fixing another plumbers mess up. Definitely 100% recommend them for all plumbing issues!

reviewsSample.author: Armani Na'opio Kea'kalina Sabado - Ewing
reviewsSample.text: Josiah and his co worker arrived on time to check out my plumbing issue and they were very descriptive with explaining what needed to be done breaking it down for me were even fair in price ! I would recommend united drain techs to my friends and family most definitely !

reviewsSample.author: Lioness and Lambie and More
reviewsSample.text: Im called at 1 in the morning., i thought they were 24/7. They're Awesome the Plumber came right away.  Fixed my toilet valve. Im very pleased he worked really fast and now we have no more leaks, Omg im so happy 😃. Josiah did a great job🤙🏽 …

reviewsSample.author: Jon Tan
reviewsSample.text:
I recently hired Fabian from FV Plumbing to replace my sump pump and backup sump pump, and I couldn’t be more satisfied with the experience. From start to finish, Fabian was incredibly professional. He provided a very reasonable and detailed quote, including the exact models of the pumps and battery used. He even encouraged me to contact his supplier directly if I had any questions—something I really appreciated.

The work itself was done perfectly and very neatly. In addition to the sump pumps, Fabian also addressed a leak from my water heater’s pressure relief valve. He replaced the expansion tank and check valve, flushed the tank, and took the time to explain how the water heater system works. He even pointed out the signs I should watch for when the tank is nearing the end of its life. Another company had quoted me for a full replacement, but Fabian’s honest and knowledgeable approach saved me from an unnecessary expense.

He also installed two bidets for us, and like the other jobs, the work was done with precision and care. The before-and-after photos really show how detail-oriented he is.

Overall, I highly recommend Fabian and FV Plumbing. His professionalism, honesty, and high-quality work truly stand out.

reviewsSample.author: Andrea
reviewsSample.text: Absolutely exceptional - beginning to end. Communication and scheduling was fantastic. Our 1906 sewer line was threatening to give up the ghost.  Our first visit from another company was completely incorrect and Bobby was the second opinion we definitely needed!  Use of the hydrovac truck to install our 6" cleanout kept our (obsessive) landscaping pristine - no giant soil tombstone in our front yard for a year!   The crew showed up on time, every time and did a phenomenal job.  They are all masters of their craft and are super warm and friendly.  The technology is fascinating and when they left, it was like they were never there!  I can't recommend this company enough - really great experience that I'll share with everyone!  Thanks NuFlow team!

reviewsSample.author: James Hafer
reviewsSample.text:
We have a 1932 craftsman house with original clay sewer line. We had a sewer back up into our family room in the basement after a bad storm. Called a local plumber. They scoped the line and found tree roots almost obstructing the sewer line in a couple of places. They then had another man come and speak to me about replacing the entire sewer line, and putting in a cleanout in the yard. They would dig up a large portion of my lawn to do so. Then it started, the sales tactics, more high pressure statements of what would happen if this was not taken care of promptly etc. When I said I was getting other estimates. He was rather abrupt, and left.
I then called NuFlow. From the very beginning, starting with Michelle in the office an entirely different tone. We scheduled an appointment to have them come to our home. Bobby was so knowledgeable, personable, and we discussed our options. NuFlow scoped the line with video. Bobby showed me the line video and what was there. We discussed options again. No pressure at all. I had the estimate in my email for the work we discussed with in 48 hours. We had a clean out placed then the entire line hydro-jetted to remove all the roots from the line. After they were done, the entire line was scoped again to make sure all was cleared. And the best part was, they only had to dig about a 4x4 area on my lawn to get down to the sewer line and to place the clean-out. And the clean-out is almost flush with the ground! No big unsightly tube sticking up in the middle of your front yard! And the cost was about $3000 less than the plumbing company quote.
A fantastic company to deal with from beginning to the end. All are personable, friendly, professional and very knowledgeable. Very highly recommend NuFlow.

reviewsSample.author: K3355
reviewsSample.text:
Had a great experience with this company. These are professionals, unlike two other big companies I dealt with during our plumbing ordeal.

NuFlow was able to come out and do the trenchless UV cured-in-place pipe replacement of our main line in a single day.

We saved over $18k from what we were quoted, by a large regional plumbing company, to dig up and replace the line (and that didn’t include the cost of repairing the yard afterwards!).

reviewsSample.author: Holden Miller
reviewsSample.text:
Bobby from NuFlow was excellent to work with. He came out to provide an estimate for a broken sewer pipe after we started experiencing some backup into our home. He took the time to thoroughly assess the situation and clearly explained both an immediate fix option as well as a longer-term solution that he highly recommended.

What stood out most was how personal, understanding, and honest he was throughout the entire process. He made sure we understood our options without any pressure and was extremely professional from start to finish. He also helped get us scheduled quickly, which was a huge relief given the urgency of the issue.

So far, the entire NuFlow team has been great to work with, and we really appreciate how well they’ve taken care of us. I’ll be sure to provide another update once the work is fully completed, but based on our experience so far, I would absolutely recommend Bobby and the NuFlow team.

reviewsSample.author: Adam Heavrin
reviewsSample.text:
We live in an older home that has always had sewer backup issues a couple of times a year. We had a couple companies come out for estimates to repair the work. NuFlow was by far the most friendly and professional. When they came to do the estimate there was no charge for taking a full length video of our line - - our line is very long (95feet). They provided us the video at no charge to keep for our records. We then consulted about the price of repairing the entire line versus installing a new cleanout. NuFlow does lining to repair the pipe versus digging up the pipe which was preferable to us because we didn't want a trench in our entire front yard.

The entire line repair was quoted at $18,700 and the cleanout was quoted at $6,600. Travis Perry is the point person for all NuFlow Indy service. I was on the phone with him several times and he was nothing but friendly and answered all of my questions. NuFlow was never pushy.

NuFlow takes care of all the permits required and contacts the city to have utilities marked.

Travis worked with me on questions I had about how many vehicles would come to our house the day of the repair because our driveway is long but not very wide.

The day of the repair the crew showed up promptly and communicated with me about where best to park their vehicles so they didn't have to run all over the yard. One of the best moments is when they brought out their digger and used plywood under the tracks to save our grass....we really appreciated that attention to detail! The crew of three guys was there from 9:30a - approx 3:00p.

After the installation was done they did a cleanout of the entire line then took another video - which they sent to us for our records at no charge. This seems like a little thing but it was included with the quote/cost of the service and none of the other contractors we had come out did this. A couple said we could pay extra to get the line cleaned after the repair.

A sewer line repair is probably one of the least sexy house projects, but NuFlow Indy made did an awesome job for us. If there were 10 extra stars, they would get all of them.

reviewsSample.author: Kalie Lupton
reviewsSample.text: I can’t explain how good it was to work with them. Called to see if they installed water softeners, I had purchased mine online, and was met with an enthusiastic yes. Customer service was top notch from the office calling that morning to confirm the appointment, the tech calling on his way, and just the overall quality of the install. The tech even brought a couple of salt bags in case I had forgotten to purchase some.

reviewsSample.author: Kristen Chapman
reviewsSample.text: I highly recommend this company! Aaron is so professional and communicative. He is also very friendly and knows his stuff. He was able to figure out how to fix the sewage back up issue at the house. See pictures! Very satisfied.

reviewsSample.author: James Spencer
reviewsSample.text: Had Jason come out for root intrusion. He was very professional and knowledgeable. He had the issue resolved quickly and then ran a camera afterwards to make sure the pipes were completely cleaned out. Highly recommended

reviewsSample.author: Lewis Perkins
reviewsSample.text:
I had plumbing issues with my washer.
Wyatt Oliverson showed up. He was very professional and got right to work. He is an outstanding representative of Reddi industries. He was very respectful. Thank you Reddi for your incredible service. Five Star!!

reviewsSample.author: Mariel Wedeking
reviewsSample.text:
You know you've found a good company to work with when, when you move to a new state, you are legitimately bummed that you are going to have to find a new set of tradesmen to have to turn to. I cannot describe how kind everyone is that I've dealt with with Plumbing Solutions, how professional everyone is, and how much trust I have in this company.

When I bought my house in 2016, I knew there was a potential for issues as it was over 100 years old at the time. When I needed to get my sewer replaced, I got the honor of meeting Aaron (so sorry if I'm misspelling your name!) for the first time. This man not only explained everything to me in a way I understood, but made sure to be utterly realistic with me, walked me through the whole process of what was going to happen, and made sure to let me know if and when anything happened (surprise wiring did happen), all within their quoted amount. Every time after that, when I needed something done plumbing-wise, I knew who I was going to call and never once regretted it, and man did they do a lot of plumbing work on that house.

When it came time to sell the house, I knew who I was going to call for seller-requested work and they got me in ASAP. Aaron showed up for the first call-out, for any random subsequent call-outs, and for that final one as well - which required a lot of extra trust on my part as I wasn't in town when work was being done. Never once in that entire ordeal did I doubt that the work was done to absolute perfection.

I only wish I could pick this entire company up and move it with me because I really don't want to have to find a new plumber.

reviewsSample.text: My Easter Sunday brought a horrible sewage drain backup with flooding in my basement bathroom. reviewsSample.author: Ashley L
reviewsSample.text: Sump pump died. They came to the rescue and saved my basement from becoming an indoor pool. Same-day service, great work, and a few laughs along the way. Highly recommend!

reviewsSample.author: Susan O'Connor
reviewsSample.text: Washing machine hose sprung a leak in the evening.  Faucet kept leaking after being shut off. reviewsSample.author: Sandy Anderson
reviewsSample.text:
My sewer line became clogged after 5:00 pm, yesterday.  Both toilets clogged, bathtub and sinks didn’t drain.
Called AAA-Able Drain Cleaners at 7:30 am in the morning.  It was complicated because I have a newer home without an outlet on the outside of my house to clean the drains with an auger.  They thought it might be a city sewer problem so they called 2 more crews with bigger equipment.  In the end, they removed the toilet to get to the drain with the reel augur.  We heard water running through the drain and they both said, “That’s a good sound”, while watching the video from the camera on the end of the auger.  These guys were amazing.  When they left, everything was cleaned up and you would never know there was a clogged drain.  It took them about 1 1/2 hours.  I highly recommend them.

reviewsSample.author: Karen Howell
reviewsSample.text: They did a fantastic job! I have a 1915 house with a kitchenette upstairs. The sink did not drain. Another company came in and spent a full day with no results. AAA came in and had it working great in 40 minutes. The other company wanted me to pay another $12,000 (after charging me $1700) to replace my plumbing pipes. AAA was fast, reliable, reasonably priced, friendly and had everything working in 40 minutes.

reviewsSample.author: Amanda K
reviewsSample.text: Honestly amazing service and was open and honest with what was going on. They made a few other calls and didn't just leave me hanging. If I need anything again in the future I will be working with them and refer them for sure. Not often I give 5 stars. Yet I apprecaite the two that came to my home.

reviewsSample.author: Andrew D
reviewsSample.text: As a father of 3 kids from age 11 to 6 you can only imagine the amount of cheerios, mac n cheese, and god knows what else has been jammed down my kitchen sink. I went the lazy way at first with Drano and Roto-Rooter only to find out that my kids are able to out shine those so called "clog destroyers" jugs that are nothing but just chemical loogies that don't do sh*t. So after hearing from word of mouth from a friend called AAA this morning and was told they could get to my place in the afternoon(no big deal I have to work) only to then find out that  they can get to my house earlier, like an hour after I initially called so hell ya had them come over, told the boss I had to leave get my drain snaked. Sadly my clogged sink was no match for AAA and within about 15min of them arriving they had successfully unclogged my sink drain and were out of the house which meant my expected longer break from work was cut short. But back to AAA's service, the two guys that came (sorry forgot their names) were super nice and cool guys told me what they were doing, and went around to make sure there was nothing left that could cause an issue. TOTALLY WORTH calling if you have given up hope on a clogged sink or drain. I guess if I were to dock any points on these guys would be that for so called "plumbers" there was no crack to be found...would recommend to anyone thanks again AAA

reviewsSample.author: Collin Gassler
reviewsSample.text:
These guys are great! Was quoted $8,000 by the big guys to repair a pipe due to root growth. AAA Team took a look, cleaned the issue out, and were out the door in less than 30 mins, for a fraction of the cost!

If you are getting quoted crazy money, have AAA team give a second opinion.

10/10 would recommend, always going to these guys from now on. Can’t recommend enough!
